project_type: TypeScript/Node.js Express backend + React/TypeScript frontend (full-stack SPA served by Vite in dev, static in prod)
build_system: Vite (frontend bundler) + tsx (TypeScript Node.js runner for server). No separate compile step — tsx runs server.ts directly. ESM modules throughout (`"type": "module"` in package.json). Import paths in test files use `.ts` extension explicitly.
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner (`node:test` + `node:assert/strict`). Test command runs all `*.test.ts` files under src/lib/. Tests import with `.ts` extension (e.g. `import { ... } from './fleet.ts'`).
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run lint` (tsc --noEmit) to confirm zero TypeScript errors. 2. Run `npm run test` to run all test files. 3. Run `npm run build` to confirm Vite frontend build succeeds.
snapshot_or_generated_files: data/vizimove_store.json (auto-generated persistent JSON store — do NOT edit manually). Created by PersistentStore on first run.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Server runs on port 3000. Do not restart the dev server during tests. Auth uses VIZIMOVE_API_KEY env var; tests use process.env.VIZIMOVE_API_KEY || 'vizimove_secret_api_key_example' as the test secret.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns: ESM imports, explicit .ts extensions in test imports, Node.js test runner (not Jest/Vitest), same-origin CSRF auth for mutations.
key_patterns: 1. Persistent state lives in `persistentStore` (src/db/store.ts) — all vehicle/recommendation reads and writes go through it. 2. `globalFleetManager` and `globalRecommendationEngine` and `globalPipelineScheduler` are module-level singletons imported from their respective files. 3. Fleet state transitions: AVAILABLE → EN_ROUTE via `assignRepositioning()` or `dispatchReposition()`; EN_ROUTE → AVAILABLE via `progressAutonomousMovements()` (arrival) or cancellation rollback. 4. The 15-min pipeline scheduler (pipelineScheduler.ts) is the PRIMARY autonomous dispatch path — it already creates DISPATCHED recommendations and assigns vehicles. 5. `recommendations.ts RecommendationEngine` is a LEGACY engine (seeded on startup, manual dispatch). 6. `DriverRecommendation.allocatedVehicleIds` = the vehicle IDs assigned to this recommendation. 7. Constraint values: max 12 km distance, max 32 min travel time, source reserve ≥ 3 vehicles, 70% surplus take rate, min 2 vehicles per dispatch, max 15 vehicles per dispatch, battery threshold 20%. 8. Tests use `test()` not `describe()` blocks. Import `{ test }` from 'node:test' and `assert` from 'node:assert/strict'.
directory_structure: d:/viz 1/ — workspace root. src/lib/ — core logic (fleet, recommendations, pipeline, types, zones, events, operations, supply demand, calibration, forecasting, auth, n8nNotifier). src/db/ — store.ts (JSON flat file persistence). src/services/ — api.ts (frontend API client). src/components/views/ — React view components. server.ts — Express server + API routes. data/ — vizimove_store.json (auto-generated). n8n/ — n8n workflow JSON. .agents/tasks/autonomous-dispatch/ — planning artifacts.
